rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL: Cookie Stuffing Detection")`
`comment("Affiliates setting cookies without corresponding click events")`
index=flame_advertising sourcetype=flame:affiliate_tracking
  event_type="cookie_set"
| stats count AS cookies_set,
        dc(session_id) AS sessions,
        dc(cookie_id) AS unique_cookies,
        sum(if(cookie_source="iframe" OR cookie_source="pixel"
               OR cookie_source="script", 1, 0)) AS hidden_cookies
  BY affiliate_id, affiliate_name
| join type=left affiliate_id [
    search index=flame_advertising sourcetype=flame:affiliate_tracking
      event_type="click"
    | stats dc(click_id) AS clicks_recorded BY affiliate_id
  ]
| fillnull value=0 clicks_recorded
| where (clicks_recorded=0 AND cookies_set >= 50)
  OR (cookies_set / max(clicks_recorded, 1)) >= 5.0
| sort - cookies_set
rules.title: DL-0192: Cookie Stuffing Detection — Affiliate Cookies Set Without Corresponding Click Events (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL: Bot Traffic Behavioral Anomaly Detection")`
`comment("Detects mechanical consistency in affiliate session behavioral metrics")`
index=flame_advertising sourcetype=flame:web_analytics
  traffic_source="affiliate"
| stats count AS session_count,
        avg(session_duration_sec) AS avg_duration,
        stdev(session_duration_sec) AS duration_stddev,
        avg(scroll_depth_pct) AS avg_scroll,
        stdev(scroll_depth_pct) AS scroll_stddev,
        avg(mouse_movement_pixels) AS avg_mouse,
        stdev(mouse_movement_pixels) AS mouse_stddev,
        sum(if(mouse_movement_pixels=0, 1, 0)) AS zero_mouse_sessions,
        dc(src_ip) AS distinct_ips
  BY affiliate_id, affiliate_name
| where session_count >= 100
  AND (duration_stddev < 1.0 OR scroll_stddev < 2.0
       OR (zero_mouse_sessions / session_count) > 0.5)
| sort - session_count
rules.title: DL-0193: Bot Traffic Behavioral Anomaly — Mechanical Consistency in Affiliate Session Metrics (SPLUNK)
